oneLine: Sonaselection India Ltd. IPO details including price band and issue size.

sources.title: Sonaselection India Ltd. IPO: price band, dates, issue size, proceeds plan, financials, KPIs and risks

synopsis: Sonaselection India Limited, an integrated fabric manufacturing and processing company based in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, opened its mainboard initial public offering on 17 September 2026, closing on 21 September 2026. The price band is set at ₹94 to ₹99 per share with a lot size of 150 shares. The total issue size is ₹141.57 crore, and the entire offering is a fresh issue with no offer for sale. The company is scheduled to list on 24 September 2026.
